nodes.summary: If $u$ is an odd natural number, then $2u$ has exactly twice as many positive divisors as $u$.
nodes.title: Divisor count of twice an odd number

nodes.summary: If $n$ is a nonzero natural number and $d$ is a divisor of $n$, then $n/(n/d) = d$.
nodes.title: The complementary divisor of the complementary divisor

nodes.summary: If $n$ is a nonzero natural number and $d$ is a divisor of $n$, then $n/d$ is also a divisor of $n$.
nodes.title: Complementary divisor

nodes.summary: If $n$ is a natural number that is not a perfect square and $d$ is a divisor of $n$, then $n/d \neq d$.
nodes.title: Complementary divisors of a nonsquare are distinct

nodes.summary: If a natural number $n$ is not a perfect square, then $n$ has an even number of positive divisors.
nodes.title: A nonsquare has an even number of divisors

nodes.summary: Let $s$ be a finite subset of a type $\alpha$ and let $f : \alpha \to \alpha$ satisfy $f(a) \in s$, $f(f(a)) = a$ and $f(a) \neq a$ for every $a \in s$. Then $s$ has an even number of elements.
nodes.title: A fixed-point-free involution forces even cardinality

nodes.summary: Let $s$ be a finite subset of a type $\alpha$, let $f : \alpha \to \alpha$ satisfy $f(a) \in s$, $f(f(a)) = a$ and $f(a) \neq a$ for every $a \in s$, and let $g : \alpha \to \mathbb{Z}$ satisfy $g(f(a)) = g(a)$ for every $a \in s$. Then $\sum_{a \in s} g(a) = 2k$ for some integer $k$.
nodes.title: Sums invariant under a fixed-point-free involution are even

nodes.summary: Let $\chi_8'$ be the primitive quadratic character modulo $8$ with values in $\mathbb{Z}$ (the character of $\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{-2})$): $\chi_8'(n) = 1$ for $n \equiv 1, 3 \pmod 8$, $\chi_8'(n) = -1$ for $n \equiv 5, 7 \pmod 8$, and $\chi_8'(n) = 0$ for even $n$. For every odd natural number $d$, $\chi_8'(d) = 1$ or $\chi_8'(d) = -1$.
nodes.title: The second quadratic character mod 8 is ±1 on odd numbers

nodes.summary: Let $\chi_4$ be the nontrivial character modulo $4$ with values in $\mathbb{Z}$: $\chi_4(n) = 1$ for $n \equiv 1 \pmod 4$, $\chi_4(n) = -1$ for $n \equiv 3 \pmod 4$, and $\chi_4(n) = 0$ for even $n$. For every odd natural number $d$, $\chi_4(d) = 1$ or $\chi_4(d) = -1$.
nodes.title: The quadratic character mod 4 is ±1 on odd numbers

nodes.summary: A nonzero natural number $u$ has an odd number of positive divisors if and only if $u$ is a perfect square.
nodes.title: Squares are exactly the numbers with an odd number of divisors

nodes.summary: Let $s$ be a finite set of natural numbers and let $f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ be a function such that $f(k)$ is even for every $k \in s$. Then the natural number $\frac{1}{2} \sum_{k \in s} f(k)$ is congruent modulo $2$ to the number of elements $k \in s$ with $f(k) \equiv 2 \pmod 4$.
nodes.title: Half a sum of even numbers modulo 2

nodes.summary: Let $N$ be a natural number and let $\chi$ be a multiplicative character on $\mathbb{Z}/N\mathbb{Z}$ with values in $\mathbb{Z}$, applied to natural numbers through their residues modulo $N$. Let $n$ be a natural number that is not a perfect square such that $\chi(n) = 1$ and $\chi(d) \in \{1, -1\}$ for every positive divisor $d$ of $n$, and let $\tau(n)$ be the number of positive divisors of $n$. nodes.title: Character divisor sums modulo 4

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
